annotations.text:
The trading page, refined (Steve, 2026-09-15): stage and send an order with no agent in the loop.

One strip on every stage: PAPER/LIVE, the arming state, one clock, STOP. Then only what the stage needs. Pick a side with one tap; expiry, the delta target and RE-PRICE on one row; strikes around spot — tap one or type a delta; the ticket as three lines (what, the cut, the two legs); one action per stage — PREVIEW, then SEND, then UPDATE / FLATTEN.

Gone from the trading page: the FD0 budget and attempts inputs (behind 'more'), the 'lots' line, the quote line that repeated the ticket, the derivation table, the sha/mode footer, and every account control — unlock, stand down, lock, the weekly Schwab re-authorisation — which live on the account page, one tap away.

The δ target starts at 0.80 (Steve, 2026-09-15, from his 08-19 words). Numbers are sample values off the mock chain: the .78 row at 32.40; the target is 10× the fill as ruled.
